svg.text: Dual-Path N-Dimensional Geometry Pipeline: 3D Cascaded Projection vs. 2D Hyperplane Slicing
How a single N-D BeingEntity in Rust feeds both the Left 3D Omniscient Viewport and the Right 2D Flatland Slice Viewport
Rust Core Source: PolytopeND::transform_vertices (rust-core/src/math.rs & universe.rs)
Local k-D Polytope (vertices v_local ∈ R^k, edges E, facets F) + Position p ∈ R^N + Orientation R ∈ SO(N)
World Vertex Transform: v_world = p + R · embed(v_local, N) (for each vertex in R^N, N ≤ 6)
PATH A — Left Viewport: Cascaded N-D → 3D → 2D Projection
1. Cascaded Higher-D Fold: ProjectorND.projectNDTo3D (ProjectorND.js)
• If dim(v) ≤ 3: Exact passthrough X = v[0], Y = v[1], Z = v[2] (zero distortion)
• If dim(v) ≥ 4: For d = N-1 down to 3, perspective scale s_d = D_4 / (D_4 - x_d)
Folds x_d (w, v, u) into (X, Y, Z) with oblique basis offset + records wDepth = x_3
2. Space-Time Mode & Turntable Camera: ProjectorND.project3DTo2D
• Optional Space-Time Mode: maps Z ← Z - (T_universal - t_sample) · s_time
• Camera Orbit: rotates (X, Y, Z) by yaw θ (X-Y plane) and pitch φ (Y-Z plane)
• Screen Projection: u = W/2 + x_cam · (F / depth), v = H/2 - y_cam · (F / depth)
3. Canvas 3D Rendering: SpaceTimeVisualizer.render3DViewport
• Draws z=0 Flatland grid, z=sliceZ plane, and N-D axis gizmo (X,Y,Z,W,V,U)
• Renders translucent facets (for M ≤ 4), spectral w-depth edges & vertex nodes
• Renders vertical pulse light-cones, expanding wavefront rings & peer beams
• Supports click hit-testing within 26px screen radius to select any being
PATH B — Right Viewport: Exact Hyperplane Slicing (x_2 = z_slice)
1. Bounded O(V) Cascaded Slicing: compute_being_cross_section (Rust)
• O(1) Bounding-Sphere Pre-Check: skips if |pos[2] - z_slice| > 1.45 · radius
• For 4D/5D/6D beings (d > 3): slices higher axes x_d = 0, deduplicates points
(≤ 24 verts), and forms O(V) cyclic + antipodal-chord hull edges (≤ 2·V edges)
2. Edge-Hyperplane Intersection: CrossSectionND::slice_polytope (Rust)
• For every edge (v_a, v_b) straddling x_2 = z_slice: t = (z_slice - z_a) / (z_b - z_a)
• Interpolates exact intersection point p(t) = v_a + t · (v_b - v_a) for t ∈ [0, 1]
• Deduplicates & sorts points counter-clockwise by atan2(y - c_y, x - c_x)
3. Canvas 2D Slice Rendering: SpaceTimeVisualizer.render2DSliceViewport
• When |z_slice| < 0.65: draws native 2D polygons {p} directly from world vertices
• For 3D–6D beings: draws being.sliceAtZ.orderedPolygon2D as a dashed glowing
2D cross-section polygon (e.g. "SLICE #20 (4D→2D: 5-gon)") as they pass z_slice
• Slider #slice-z-slider updates viewer_slice_z in Rust via universe_set_slice_z
